fictional_notice: MetroPulse is a fictional, synthetic city-transit system. These are lab values produced by a deterministic simulator, not a real transit agency or a real incident.
reported_symptom: At higher concurrency, every aggregate task stalled at the same step, waiting for a database session, and then timed out. The database itself stayed nearly idle. The number of in-use sessions rose to the capacity limit and never came back down.
time_pressure: Station aggregates are not refreshing while tasks stall.
title: Every aggregate task stalls at the same step waiting for a database session
